author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: three separate chili pods stacked, each tapering to a point at the left with a rounded head and a stem flicking up at the right; matches the reference. The rejected drawing had three solid, crowded pods. A first pod with a multi-cubic belly failed the internal-spacing gate; the two-cubic pod passes.
omissions: The reference's slight downward droop of the tips is flattened; pods are identical.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L; pods on rows y 7, 23, 40 (extremes 4..11, 20..27, 37..44), tip x 8, head x 34; two cubics with equal-height controls; stems to (40, row top).
lucide_reference: No Lucide chili; tapered pod construction like 'carrot'/'leaf'.
